newsitem.title: USA: Merrill lists $100 mln Conn. refunding candidates.
newsitem.headline: Merrill lists $100 mln Conn. refunding candidates.

text.p: THE STATE OF CONNECTICUT IS CONSIDERING THE ISSUANCE OF REFUNDING BONDS TO ADVANCE REFUND ALL OR A PORTION OF THE FOLLOWING OUTSTANDING BONDS:

(I) GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1989A, DATED MARCH 1, 1989, (II) GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1990C, DATED SEPTEMBER 15, 1990, (III) GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1991A, DATED MARCH 1, 1991, (IV) GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1991C, DATED NOVEMBER 15, 1991, AND (V) GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1992A, DATED MARCH 15, 1992.
OTHER BONDS MAY BE ADVANCE REFUNDED AT THE ELECTION OF THE STATE SUBJECT TO MARKET CONDITIONS.
